critical_code_review_comments: Step-up gated admin endpoints return 403 with detail.code='mfa_enrollment_required' when only the step-up bypass header is missing (preview disables MFA). The task spec accepts either 'step_up_required' or 'mfa_enrollment_required', so this passes; but callers in preview may be misled that MFA is the actual gate. Consider returning 'step_up_required' when MFA is disabled by config and only the step-up header is missing (same nit as iter 186).

After successful login the SPA lands on '/' rather than '/dashboard'; the redirect target seems to be the root route (which does render the dashboard). Not a defect, but wait_for_url('**/dashboard**') based tests will need to be updated.
